description: Split any length at the golden ratio, or find the whole from one part, with a φ scale for type. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

decimals.description: Decimal places to round the answers to. Defaults to 3; use 0 for whole pixels.

known.description: Which length value is: "longer" (the longer part, a), "shorter" (the shorter part, b) or "total" (the whole, a + b). Defaults to "longer".

value.description: The one length you know, in any unit (px, cm, inches…). The answer is in the same unit.

name: golden_ratio_calculator
title: Golden Ratio Calculator
